use_when.text: Use clear and descriptive labels to indicate what users should enter.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

use_when.text: Use the appropriate input type based on the information being collected.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

use_when.text: Keep labels, helper text, and validation messages concise and clear.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

use_when.text: Use placeholder text only when an example or format helps users understand the expected input.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

use_when.text: Provide clear error and validation messages when input needs correction.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

use_when.text: Use the appropriate focus, error, disabled, and filled states.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

use_when.text: Keep input fields consistent in height, spacing, alignment, and styling.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

use_when.text: Use password visibility controls for Password fields when appropriate.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2194;2406:461;71:2190)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use unclear or overly long labels.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t rely on placeholder text as the only label.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use the wrong input type for the information being collected.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use inconsistent formats for the same type of information.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t leave users without clear feedback when their input is invalid.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use error messages that do not explain how to correct the input.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t add unnecessary input fields when the information is not required.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t expose password values as plain text by default.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2194 (Input Field Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2194;2406:416;71:2187)

a11y.text: The label is a native <label> tied to the input’s id.
The input is type="password" while hidden and type="text" while shown.
The show/hide toggle’s aria-label is "Show <labelText>", and its aria-pressed is true while the password is shown.
The show/hide toggle is in the tab order.
state="disable" sets disabled on the input.
The error states ("error visible", "error invisible") set aria-invalid on the input.
